title: Company Settings
description: Learn how to configure company information, branding, and account-level settings for your Tijraa account.
content:
Company Settings

Configure company information, branding, and account-level settings to personalize your Tijraa account and represent your business.

Company Information

Set up your company details:

  • Company name
  • Company logo
  • Company address
  • Contact information
  • Tax ID/VAT number
  • Business registration number

Branding

Configure your brand identity:

  • Company logo
  • Favicon
  • Brand colors
  • Company tagline
  • Social media links

Contact Information

Set up contact details:

  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Support email
  • Sales email
  • Physical address
  • Business hours

Account Settings

Configure account-level settings:

  • Account name
  • Account type
  • Subscription plan
  • Billing information
  • Account status

Regional Settings

Set regional preferences:

  • Default timezone
  • Date format
  • Time format
  • Currency
  • Language
  • Country/region

Notification Preferences

Configure notification settings:

  • Email notifications
  • SMS notifications
  • Push notifications
  • Notification frequency
  • Notification types

Billing Information

Manage billing details:

  • Billing address
  • Payment method
  • Invoice settings
  • Billing history
  • Tax information

Account Limits

View account limits based on your plan:

  • Number of stores
  • Number of products
  • Storage space
  • Number of users
  • API rate limits

Best Practices

  • Keep company information updated
  • Use consistent branding
  • Provide accurate contact information
  • Set appropriate timezone
  • Configure notifications properly
  • Review account limits regularly

  • Security Settings
